annotations.title: Measure what makes a fragment hard to synthesise

description: Measure the sequence features gene-synthesis vendors screen on — repeats (the single largest cause of synthesis failure), GC extremes, GC swings between adjacent windows, homopolymer runs and hairpin-forming inverted repeats — and report each against the threshold vendors publish. Returns measurements and named flags, never a success probability: refitted on the 303 REAL orders its authors publish (scripts/ssc-eval), the published classifier scores F1 0.866 against 0.878 for assuming every order succeeds, and transfers between ordering labs at AUC 0.423 — below chance. Pair with nonrepetitive_parts_design to fix the repeats it finds.

includeProfile.description: Return the full per-window GC profile. Off by default — it is one row per window and most callers want the flags.

repeatMin.description: Shortest repeated stretch to report, in bp (default 20, which is where vendor repeat filters sit).

sequence.description: The fragment as it would be ordered, raw, FASTA or GenBank. Max 100,000 bp.

window.description: Window for the GC profile, in bp (default 50). Vendors screen local GC, not just the average, so this is what the flags are computed over.
